description:
Classic Truck Bike, Unisex frame with unique "Steer-tru" system, large "fixed to frame" perforated steel cargo basket, and built in parking stand. 20x2.125 front wheel, 26x2.125 rear wheel

Unisex Low Gravity Bike w/ Basket featuring step-over frame. Classic Delivery Bike that has been seen from the streets of New York to the Movie Studios in Los Angeles for more than 50 years. Many people refer to them as "Truck Bikes". Shown with new style Perforated Steel LGB Basket More important are the benefits businesses gain from using these bikes to deliver small packages in Urban or campus settings. See how this young entrepreneur got started using Worksman Low Gravity Delivery Bikes! Worksman Low Gravity Bikes have a unique "Balance Tru" Steering System whereby the handlebars turn but the huge 24x17x12" flat steel basket does not. This allows bulkier loads to be transported. Also, Low Gravity Bikes have the unique built-in parking stand. Could your business benefit by using Worksman Delivery Bicycles rather than cars? Thank about it. The Green Solution that saves lots of "Green". Worksman Industrial Bikes are proudly made in our Solar Powered New York City (Ozone Park) factory
